abort.already_configured: Cross-Platform Device Sync is already configured.

error.dashboard_not_found: One or more selected dashboard views could not be read. Choose again or enter a path manually.
error.dashboard_required: Select at least one dashboard view.
error.dashboard_selection_conflict: Manual path entry cannot be selected together with dashboard views.
error.empty_source: The selected source contains no entities. Choose a non-empty source to prevent unintended removals.
error.entity_not_found: One or more selected entities no longer exist.
error.target_required: Select at least one target platform.
error.invalid_target: One or more target platforms are invalid.
error.invalid_path: Enter a relative YAML path inside the Home Assistant configuration directory.
error.homekit_entry_required: Select at least one HomeKit Bridge or Accessory.
error.homekit_target_entry_not_found: One or more selected managed HomeKit entries no longer exist. Choose from the current Bridge and Accessory entries.
error.homekit_target_configuration_invalid: One or more selected HomeKit targets cannot be managed as an exact Bridge or Accessory list. Use an enabled, UI-created main Bridge with explicit filters. YAML/import entries are allowed only as fixed single-entity Accessories in Accessory mode.
error.homekit_source_entry_required: Select at least one HomeKit Bridge or Accessory as the source.
error.homekit_source_entry_not_found: One or more selected HomeKit source entries no longer exist. Choose from the current integration entries.
error.homekit_source_entry_unavailable: The selected HomeKit source settings could not be validated. Check the selected entries and try again.
error.homekit_source_filter_unsupported: One or more selected HomeKit source entries cannot be read as an exact entity set. Configure an explicit entity list before continuing.
error.invalid_matter_endpoint: Enter a valid Matterbridge host, IP address, or ws/wss/http/https management endpoint.
error.include_exclude_conflict: The same entity cannot be both added and excluded.
error.protected_rule_conflict: This selection conflicts with a protected deployment rule.
error.google_setup_required: Google Assistant is not ready for exact synchronization. Complete the integration, account link, dedicated device file, default exposure, and Request Sync setup.
error.homekit_setup_required: HomeKit is not ready. Check the selected Bridge and Accessory entries and ensure they are loaded.
error.matter_setup_required: Matterbridge is not ready. Check its connection and Home Assistant plugin.
error.platform_unavailable: A selected source or target platform is not ready. Check its integration and try again.

dashboard.title: Choose dashboard views
dashboard.description: Select one or more dashboard views whose devices should become the synchronization source.

data_description.source_page: Multiple selections are supported. The list shows each readable dashboard and view name together with its path.

dashboard_path.title: Enter a dashboard path
dashboard_path.description: Use this fallback when a dashboard page cannot be listed automatically.

manual.title: Choose source entities
manual.description: Select one or more entities as the synchronization source.

data_description.source_entities: At least one existing entity is required.

homekit_source.title: Select HomeKit Bridges and Accessories to sync
homekit_source.description: Directly check one or more Home Assistant HomeKit Bridges or Accessories to use as the read-only synchronization source. This list does not represent accessories paired natively in Apple Home.

data_description.homekit_source_entry_ids: Check one or more items directly. The integration reads only the selected entries; this selection does not grant permission to update them.

targets.title: Choose target platforms
targets.description: Select one or more platforms that should receive the source device set. Selected targets converge to an exact final set: existing exposures outside the source, always-include list, and protected rules are removed; exclusions stay absent. Only selected targets show target-specific settings.

data_description.target_platforms: A platform not selected as a target is not validated or synchronized as a target. If it is the source, its required connection settings and monitoring still apply.

platform_settings.title: Configure selected platforms
platform_settings.description:
Only settings required by the source and selected target platforms are shown.

{prerequisites}

data_description.google_config_path: Relative YAML file loaded by Google Assistant entity_config. Google Home targets require this dedicated file and expose_by_default set to false.
data_description.homekit_managed_entry_ids: Select the UI-managed main Bridge this integration may update. You may also select independent UI-managed Bridges or Accessories to update, and exact imported single-entity Accessories that remain fixed and read-only.
data_description.matter_host: Host name, IP address, or full ws/wss/http/https management endpoint of the Matterbridge service.
data_description.matter_port: Management API port of the Matterbridge service.
data_description.matter_password: Optional Matterbridge frontend password. It is stored in the Home Assistant Config Entry and never included in diagnostics.
data_description.google_include: Additional entities to synchronize to Google Home even when absent from the source.
data_description.google_exclude: Entities that must not be synchronized to Google Home.
data_description.homekit_include: Additional entities to synchronize to HomeKit even when absent from the source.
data_description.homekit_exclude: Entities that must not be synchronized to HomeKit.
data_description.matter_include: Additional entities to synchronize to Matterbridge even when absent from the source.
data_description.matter_exclude: Entities that must not be synchronized to Matterbridge.

confirm.title: Review settings
confirm.description:
Review the settings below. No source or target configuration is changed until you submit this final step. Selected targets then converge to their exact final sets; unselected targets stay unchanged.

{summary}

preview.name: Preview synchronization
preview.description: Calculate exact target changes without applying them. When synchronization is off, the service returns disabled without reading a source.

sync_now.name: Synchronize now
sync_now.description: Apply exact target sets immediately only while synchronization is enabled.
